name: Last Week at the Job
source:
A Disco-Elysium inspired short spin-off that serves as an experimental prequel to Desire: Girls With no Dreams. About burnout, mental illness, dead-end jobs and living an ordinary life in the face of a dying world.

[From [url=https://desire-gwnd.itch.io/last-week-at-the-job]itch.io[/url]]
